description.name: bKash Manual Payment
description.tagline: Accept manual bKash payments for WHMCS invoices.
description.long: bKash Manual Payment allows clients to pay invoices by bKash and submit their Transaction ID, sender number, and paid amount for manual verification by your billing team.
features: Manual bKash payment instructions on WHMCS invoices
Professional payment popup without breaking invoice layout
Transaction ID submission through support ticket
Configurable bKash number, payment type, business name, and department ID
